gather.answer: Draft answer for 4.2.1, from the evidence found.

requirements.reason: Request, approval, least privilege and removal are defined, and the tickets show them followed.

citations.quote: Rights that are no longer needed are removed within five working days of the manager telling IT.
January to September 2026: 12 joiners, 7 movers and 9 leavers.

requirements.reason: User, administrator and technical accounts are reviewed, but not rights in customers' systems.

citations.quote: The access rights of all accounts, including administrator and technical accounts, are reviewed every six months by the role owners.
All accounts in the directory, the ERP and the CAD system: 171 employee accounts, 9 administrator accounts, 14 supplier accounts and 6 technical accounts.

requirements.reason: Access starts from none and follows the job.

citations.quote: Access to information is granted on the basis of the job a person does.

requirements.reason: Rights are bundled into owned roles, and the role owners review them.

citations.quote: Rights are bundled into roles, such as purchasing, engineering, production planning and finance.
Roles and their rights | Role owners | 2026-06-27 | 14 roles | n/a | 6

requirements.reason: Only what the job needs is granted; other requests are refused.

citations.quote: We start from no access and add only what the job needs.

requirements.reason: Administrator rights only on separate administrator accounts, as the rollout record shows.

citations.quote: Administrator rights are given only to separate administrator accounts.
All 9 administrator accounts are separate from their owners' everyday accounts and require a hardware security key since 15 April 2026.

requirements.reason: Old-role rights go when new ones are granted; ticket IT-2026-0231 shows it.

citations.quote: When someone moves to a new job, IT removes the rights of the old role at the same time as it grants the new one.
IT-2026-0231 | Mover | Head of engineering | CAD owner | 2026-03-16 | Engineering role granted, production planning role removed the same day
